# Outpost

> Outpost is a free daily briefing on cybersecurity, modern warfare technology, geodata and geopolitics, compiled from open sources. Every story links to the outlet that reported it.

## Sections
- [Top stories](https://www.outpostdaily.com/): the best of cyber, warfare tech and geopolitics today
- [Cyber](https://www.outpostdaily.com/cyber/): breaches, campaigns, advisories
- [Exploited vulnerabilities](https://www.outpostdaily.com/cves/): CISA KEV with CVSS
- [Warfare](https://www.outpostdaily.com/warfare/): drones, EW, missiles, defence systems
- [Geopolitics & geodata](https://www.outpostdaily.com/geopolitics/): strategy, geo wars, GNSS and satellite security
- [Today & Learn](https://www.outpostdaily.com/today/): top 5, defender checklist, concepts explained
- [Archive](https://www.outpostdaily.com/archive/): all past editions

## Reference
- [Methodology](https://www.outpostdaily.com/methodology/): how the briefing is compiled and its limits
- [RSS feed](https://www.outpostdaily.com/feed.xml)
- [Source code](https://github.com/kyrillidis/outpostdaily)
